claim: Metal-organic frameworks were the subject of the 2025 Nobel Chemistry Prize announced in Stockholm, Sweden.

sources.shows: The Royal Swedish Academy’s 2025 press release identifies metal-organic frameworks as the prize topic.

claim: The 2022 HTTP status code for a disallowed known method is higher than the code for an unimplemented method worldwide.

sources.shows: MDN gives 501 for an unsupported method and says general-purpose servers must support GET and HEAD.
MDN gives 405 for a recognized method disallowed on the target.

claim: In 1803, President Jefferson sent Robert Livingston to join James Monroe in France to negotiate for New Orleans.
what_is_correct: Jefferson sent an envoy to join an existing U.S. negotiator in France in 1803.
what_needs_correction: James Monroe joined Robert Livingston, not the reverse.
corrected_claim: In 1803, President Jefferson sent James Monroe to join Robert Livingston in France to negotiate for New Orleans.

sources.shows: The State Department describes the 1803 purchase as a transaction with France negotiated by Livingston and Monroe.
